scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:rust
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt && npm run format:markdown
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && npm run format:markdown:check
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rust
scripts.coverage:be: cd src-tauri && cargo tarpaulin --skip-clean --engine llvm --fail-under 100 --out Html
scripts.coverage:be:clean: cd src-tauri && cargo tarpaulin --engine llvm --fail-under 100 --out Html
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:fe && npm run coverage:be
scripts.coverage:clean: npm run coverage:fe && npm run coverage:be:clean
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint:all && npm run test:all
